verdict.rationale: 2FAS supports export files (encrypted, password-protectable) and syncing, plus import from several other apps, showing some portability, but there's no evidence the export format is an open/readable standard (e.g. plaintext otpauth/URI or documented schema) rather than a proprietary encrypted 2FAS-specific file. missing for 10: documented open export format spec, evidence of interoperability with arbitrary other TOTP apps beyond 2FAS's own import list, independent confirmation of readable/portable export.
